messages:
ashley: Quick docs PR: small fixes for the airgap cert-rotation playbook. Noticed we tell customers to copy certs to /opt/redwood/certs without mentioning selinux or permission bits.
boris: Good catch. Add a note about `chcon` for selinux and `chmod 640` + owner `redwood:redwood`.
anya: Also we should add a one-liner to generate a CA bundle for offline installs: `cat cert1.pem cert2.pem > /etc/ssl/certs/airgap-ca.pem`. Warn about ordering (leafs last).
ashley: I'll include the SELinux example and a short snippet showing how to rotate without downtime: 1) upload new certs to a new dir, 2) run `redwoodctl certs install --dir /opt/redwood/certs.new`, 3) tell services to reload.
boris: Add a troubleshooting bullet: if services fail to reload, check `journalctl -u redwood-api` for TLS handshake errors and run `openssl s_client -connect :8443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/airgap-ca.pem` to debug.
docs-bot: Reminder: if you change commands, update the short code block sample rendering in the mkdocs theme tests.
ashley: Will open PR in ~10m. tagging @boris and @anya for quick review. :thumbsup:
